basic_info.description: This artful Mediterranean residence, set in exotic native gardens has been lovingly modernized over years of careful restoration & stewardship. The handsome public rooms are clad in mahogany millwork, substantial doors, pristine parquet & wrought-iron hardware setting a glamorous tone. The majestic formal living room, graced with ornate stone fireplace, tall windows & vaulted ceiling evokes a bygone era of sophistication, elevated by elegant interior design. Luminous & airy, natural light floods the space through massive windows embraced by views of the tailored landscape. The formal dining room leads to a professionally equipped, custom, eat-in kitchen, full pantry, excellent counter space, all wrapped in south facing windows. 3 bedrooms on this level share a pristine marble bath & Western outlooks to the Pacific. A guest suite & family room downstairs offer flexible options for work, play, guests & access to the fenced backyard. A huge garage includes a workshop & storage as well as development potential. The intimacy & level walkability of this leafy block of detached homes is a quintessential aspect of Balboa Terrace life: easy access to West Portal, parks, shopping & West Side amenities such as Stern Grove, Stonestown & Ocean Avenue retail. Don't miss!
